task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text: I've hardened the importer, and it now handles the export format described in `README.md`. A bad row is reported with the line it starts on and skipped, and the rest of the file still imports. Before the change, 3 of the 4 existing tests failed. All 4 now pass, along with 13 new
digest: Read 2 files (2 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
